import java.util.*;
public class p88 {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
		Scanner in = new Scanner(System.in);
		long l = in.nextLong();
		long r = in.nextLong();
		if (l%2!=0) {
			l++;
		}
		if (Math.abs(l-r)<2) {
			System.out.println(-1);
		}else {
			System.out.println(l+" "+(l+1)+" "+(l+2));
		}
	}

}
